title: Cover remaining Binding transport outcome branches with authenticated regressions
outcome: Add direct authenticated Binding coverage for replay-counter refusal, handler deadline expiry, sender post-dispatch local 423 and signed status mapping while preserving the original operation key/reservation; do not change production limits or weaken MAC admission.
acceptance: Authenticated tests directly distinguish replay/deadline/post-dispatch uncertainty from proven pre-admission refusals and assert original operation-key/reservation retention.
Tests exercise the production Binding RPC/MAC path with controlled phases; no unverified response is settled as an authenticated application result.
